objective: Define the smallest hardening boundary for the non-executing native-parser handoff-contract-to-operator-plan fixture before any execution-boundary definition: reject bool values in positive-integer fields, fail closed for the scoped malformed Mapping cases before command or operator-plan authorities, and keep efficiency_estimate as planning metadata rather than new timing or speedup evidence.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted metadata-only operator-plan fixture uses positive integer checks that can accept bool because bool is an int subclass. The fixture also validates only the scoped ready handoff-contract shape and tested malformed/prepopulated cases, not arbitrary adversarial Mapping schemas. Finally, efficiency_estimate may include existing-report-derived values when reports already exist, so it must remain planning metadata and must not become new timing or speedup evidence from this gate.
definition_decision.operator_goal: A future implementation may harden the existing importable helper in place, add focused contract tests for bool rejection and estimate-boundary wording, and keep the public wrapper thin while leaving command execution, operator-plan execution, RTL simulation, compare execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, source-closure inference, arbitrary filelist expansion, and automatic allocation absent.

positive_integer_hardening.allowed_implementation_strategy: reject bool explicitly before accepting int values
